in_hebrew.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Marigold is a modern name derived from the English term 'marigold,' which means 'golden flower.' In Hebrew, there is no direct equivalent for the term 'marigold,' but we can represent its meaning by using the Hebrew words 'שְׁמֹנָה' (shmoneh), which means 'eight,' and 'ציון' (tsion), which means 'gold,' to convey the idea of 'golden flower'.

in_greek.name: Χρυσάνθεμος
in_greek.long_meaning: In Greek, Marigold is represented by the name 'Χρυσάνθεμος' (Chrysanthos), which directly translates to 'golden flower.' This name reflects the meaning and origin of the English term 'marigold.'

in_latin.name: Aurantium
